about_the_game:
Unleash arcane devastation with relics of forgotten power and garments woven in sacred rites.

Step into the role of a true spellcaster with the Wizard Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original. This powerful gear set is crafted for mages who command the elements, bend time, and rewrite fate with a flick of the wrist.

Includes the following exclusive magic items:

  • Mysterious Magic Wand – A refined wand pulsing with arcane energy, ideal for fast, precise spellcasting and swift magical strikes.

  • Mysterious Magic Staff – A staff of immense magical potency, used to channel grand spells and destructive bursts of power.

  • Mysterious Magic Book – A tome bound in enchanted leather, containing long-lost incantations and amplifying the wielder’s spell mastery.

Blessed Man Uniform Set:

  • Blessed Man Uniform Helm

  • Blessed Man Uniform Chest

  • Blessed Man Uniform Leggings

  • Blessed Man Uniform Gloves

  • Blessed Man Uniform Boots

An elegant mage’s attire, blessed by ancient priests and reinforced with magical threads. Offers enhanced mana flow, casting speed, and elemental resistance.

Whether you fight with fire, ice, or the void itself, the Wizard Equipment Package ensures you're robed in power and prepared to dominate any battlefield with sheer magical force.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.

  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
